name: "Cluster Test CI"

on:
  workflow_call:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  cluster-test:
    timeout-minutes: 120
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    env:
      USE_STAGE: 'false' # Whether to include the stage repository.

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 5

      - name: Install project JDK
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          java-version-file: .github/workflows/.java-version
          distribution: 'zulu'
          cache: maven
          cache-jdk: false

      - name: use staged maven repo settings
        if: ${{ env.USE_STAGE == 'true' }}
        run: |
          cp $HOME/.m2/settings.xml /tmp/settings.xml
          mv -vf .github/configs/settings.xml $HOME/.m2/settings.xml

      - name: Package
        run: |
          mvn clean package -U -Dmaven.javadoc.skip=true -Dmaven.test.skip=true -ntp

      - name: Run simple cluster test
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          suite_log="$RUNNER_TEMP/simple-cluster-test.log"
          timeout 45m mvn test -pl hugegraph-cluster-test/hugegraph-clustertest-test \
            -am -P simple-cluster-test 2>&1 | tee "$suite_log"
          hugegraph-server/hugegraph-dist/src/assembly/travis/check-java-runtime-logs.sh "$suite_log"

      - name: Run multi cluster test
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          suite_log="$RUNNER_TEMP/multi-cluster-test.log"
          timeout 45m mvn test -pl hugegraph-cluster-test/hugegraph-clustertest-test \
            -am -P multi-cluster-test 2>&1 | tee "$suite_log"
          hugegraph-server/hugegraph-dist/src/assembly/travis/check-java-runtime-logs.sh "$suite_log"

      - name: Show cluster diagnostics on failure
        if: failure()
        run: |
          echo "[ci] java processes:"
          ps -ef | grep -E "HugeGraph|hg-|java" | grep -v grep || true
          echo "[ci] listening tcp ports:"
          (ss -ltnp || netstat -ltnp || true) 2>&1
          find hugegraph-cluster-test -path '*/logs/*' -type f | sort | while read -r log; do
            echo "--- tail -n 200 $log ---"
            tail -n 200 "$log" || true
          done
          find . -path '*/surefire-reports/*' -type f \
            \( -name '*.txt' -o -name '*.xml' \) | sort | while read -r report; do
            echo "--- tail -n 120 $report ---"
            tail -n 120 "$report" || true
          done

tests:

templates:
  - server-deployment.yaml
tests:
  - it: accepts an empty token value, which defers to autoGenerate
    asserts:
      - hasDocuments:
          count: 1

  - it: accepts a signing key of at least 32 characters
    set:
      server.auth.token.value: ktestJwtSigningKey2026xyzABCDEFGH12345678

      - hasDocuments:
          count: 1

      server.auth.token.value: tooshortkey
    asserts:
      - failedTemplate: {}

suite: PD and Store pod securityContext keeps fsGroup for the non-root images
templates:
  - pd-statefulset.yaml
  - store-statefulset.yaml
tests:
  - it: defaults fsGroup to the image user
    asserts:
      - equal:
          path: spec.template.spec.securityContext
          value:
            fsGroup: 10001
            fsGroupChangePolicy: OnRootMismatch
  - it: still sets fsGroup when a reused release has no podSecurityContext
    set:
      pd.podSecurityContext: null
      store.podSecurityContext: null
    asserts:
      - equal:
          path: spec.template.spec.securityContext
          value:
            fsGroup: 10001
            fsGroupChangePolicy: OnRootMismatch
  - it: keeps an explicit fsGroup and other settings
    set:
      pd.podSecurityContext:
        fsGroup: 2000
        runAsNonRoot: true
      store.podSecurityContext:
        fsGroup: 2000
        runAsNonRoot: true
    asserts:
      - equal:
          path: spec.template.spec.securityContext.fsGroup
          value: 2000
      - equal:
          path: spec.template.spec.securityContext.runAsNonRoot
          value: true
  - it: keeps an explicit fsGroupChangePolicy
    set:
      pd.podSecurityContext:
        fsGroupChangePolicy: Always
      store.podSecurityContext:
        fsGroupChangePolicy: Always
    asserts:
      - equal:
          path: spec.template.spec.securityContext
          value:
            fsGroup: 10001
            fsGroupChangePolicy: Always

suite: Server auth checksum and secret wiring
templates:
  - server-deployment.yaml
tests:
  - it: stamps a checksum/auth annotation on the pod template
    asserts:
      - matchRegex:
          path: spec.template.metadata.annotations["checksum/auth"]
          pattern: "^[a-f0-9]{64}$"

  - it: keeps a valid checksum when an external admin Secret is supplied
    set:
      server.auth.admin.existingSecret: [REDACTED]
      server.auth.admin.key: password
    asserts:
      - matchRegex:
          path: spec.template.metadata.annotations["checksum/auth"]
          pattern: "^[a-f0-9]{64}$"

  - it: never places credential material in pod metadata
    set:
      server.auth.admin.password: [REDACTED]
      server.auth.token.value: t0k3nvalu3PADDINGtoREACH32charsMIN
    asserts:
      - notMatchRegex:
          path: spec.template.metadata.annotations["checksum/auth"]
          pattern: "(sup3rs3cr3tpw|t0k3nvalu3PADDING)"

  - it: sources the admin password from a Secret, never a literal value
    set:
      server.auth.admin.password: [REDACTED]
    asserts:
      - exists:
          path: spec.template.spec.containers[0].env[?(@.name=="PASSWORD")].valueFrom.secretKeyRef
      - notExists:
          path: spec.template.spec.containers[0].env[?(@.name=="PASSWORD")].value

  - it: points the admin Secret ref at an operator-supplied Secret when set
    set:
      server.auth.admin.existingSecret: [REDACTED]
    asserts:
      - equal:
          path: spec.template.spec.containers[0].env[?(@.name=="PASSWORD")].valueFrom.secretKeyRef.name
          value: ext-admin-secret

  - it: shares one JWT signing key across replicas via a Secret ref
    asserts:
      - exists:
          path: spec.template.spec.containers[0].env[?(@.name=="HG_SERVER_AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET")].valueFrom.secretKeyRef

# Each rollout checksum picks its revision input by credential source. These
# cases pin the exact digest, so they fail if the parts list changes at all,
# not merely if it stops being 64 hex characters. Each expected value is
# sha256 of the parts joined with "|", computed outside Helm:
#
#   inline PD value   sha256("t-pd-auth|secret-key|" + sha256(value))
#   PD existingSecret sha256("byo-pd-secret|secret-key")
#
# The existingSecret cases are the ones that prove the selection: the inline
# value is set there too, and it must not reach the annotation, because the
# Pods do not read it.
#
# These cases cover the inline half; auth_checksum_lookup_test.yaml renders
# the lookup half against fake live Secrets (generated: value digest;
# existingSecret: [REDACTED] The live rollout counts belong to the
# lifecycle run.
suite: Rollout checksum revision source
release:
  name: t
tests:
  - it: hashes the inline PD value with the Secret name and key, and nothing else
    template: pd-statefulset.yaml
    set:
      pd.auth.value: pd-secret-steady
    asserts:
      - equal:
          path: spec.template.metadata.annotations["checksum/pd-auth"]
          value: c3e18a4d518ea495ef75e4fec03a68675b23ef0be93714e7a777fbb50a5957c1

  - it: drops the inline PD digest once an existingSecret supplies the credential
    template: pd-statefulset.yaml
    set:
      pd.auth.existingSecret: [REDACTED]
      pd.auth.value: ignored-by-the-pods
    asserts:
      - equal:
          path: spec.template.metadata.annotations["checksum/pd-auth"]
          value: 86fdc89040752c37324032343cd1d9a53ca23a46f724689dd61c2f5f829c0d33

  - it: hashes both inline Server credentials with their Secret names and keys
    template: server-deployment.yaml
    set:
      server.auth.admin.password: admin-after
      server.auth.token.value: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
    asserts:
      - equal:
          path: spec.template.metadata.annotations["checksum/auth"]
          value: d6ce6518e8b740a46bbacf0b55e4094580048c87912c85f21448b701f972fd72

  - it: selects the admin and token sources independently
    template: server-deployment.yaml
    set:
      server.auth.admin.existingSecret: byo-admin
      server.auth.admin.password: [REDACTED]
      server.auth.token.value: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
    asserts:
      - equal:
          path: spec.template.metadata.annotations["checksum/auth"]
          value: 7f13191bccb01ef3b2c6ffcce2fc6b6a73a6c6416583dcc4c593a5cfde1a24a0

  - it: keeps credential plaintext out of the annotation
    template: server-deployment.yaml
    set:
      server.auth.admin.password: [REDACTED]
      server.auth.token.value: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
    asserts:
      - notMatchRegex:
          path: spec.template.metadata.annotations["checksum/auth"]
          pattern: admin-plaintext-value
      - notMatchRegex:
          path: spec.template.metadata.annotations["checksum/auth"]
          pattern: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef

# The membership and identity guards read the live StatefulSets through
# lookup. These cases fake that object, so the refused path (a raft port
# change, a rename, a replica shrink) and the allowed path (an unchanged
# upgrade, a fresh install) are both pinned at render time. validateValues
# is included from the Server Deployment, so the refusals render that.
# The lookup half of the rollout checksums, rendered against fake live
# Secrets. A chart-generated Secret contributes the digest of its data, so
# a render that finds the Secret (every upgrade) equals the install render
# (which hashes the value it writes): no roll on a no-change upgrade. An
# operator-supplied existingSecret contributes its resourceVersion. Each
# expected value is sha256 of the parts joined with "|", computed outside
# Helm, as in auth_checksum_source_test.yaml.
suite: Rollout checksum lookup half against live Secrets
templates:
  - pd-statefulset.yaml
  - server-deployment.yaml
kubernetesProvider:
  scheme:
    "v1/Secret":
      gvr:
        version: v1
        resource: secrets
      namespaced: true
    # The identity guards list StatefulSets; the fake client registers the
    # list kind only for kinds that have an object, so one StatefulSet of
    # another release is faked (which the guards must ignore).
    "apps/v1/StatefulSet":
      gvr:
        group: apps
        version: v1
        resource: statefulsets
      namespaced: true
  objects:
    - apiVersion: apps/v1
      kind: StatefulSet
      metadata:
        name: other-hugegraph-pd
        namespace: NAMESPACE
        labels:
          app.kubernetes.io/instance: other
          app.kubernetes.io/component: pd
      spec:
        replicas: "1"
    - apiVersion: v1
      kind: Secret
      metadata:
        name: RELEASE-NAME-pd-auth
        namespace: NAMESPACE
        resourceVersion: "41"
      data:
        secret-key: cGQtc2VjcmV0LXN0ZWFkeQ==
    - apiVersion: v1
      kind: Secret
      metadata:
        name: byo-pd-secret
        namespace: NAMESPACE
        resourceVersion: "100"
      data:
        secret-key: b3BlcmF0b3ItY2hvc2Vu
    - apiVersion: v1
      kind: Secret
      metadata:
        name: RELEASE-NAME-admin
        namespace: NAMESPACE
        resourceVersion: "42"
      data:
        password: [REDACTED]
    - apiVersion: v1
      kind: Secret
      metadata:
        name: RELEASE-NAME-auth-token
        namespace: NAMESPACE
        resourceVersion: "43"
      data:
        token_secret: [REDACTED]
    - apiVersion: v1
      kind: Secret
      metadata:
        name: byo-admin
        namespace: NAMESPACE
        resourceVersion: "7"
      data:
        password: [REDACTED]
tests:
  - it: hashes the live generated PD Secret by its value, not its resourceVersion
    template: pd-statefulset.yaml
    asserts:
      - equal:
          path: spec.template.metadata.annotations["checksum/pd-auth"]
          value: c28abf86b4f58b426476d7d7d95dc9bc0aee3f87d64616b5314a823eb3285328

  - it: renders the same PD checksum when the inline value equals the live value
    template: pd-statefulset.yaml
    set:
      pd.auth.value: pd-secret-steady
    asserts:
      - equal:
          path: spec.template.metadata.annotations["checksum/pd-auth"]
          value: c28abf86b4f58b426476d7d7d95dc9bc0aee3f87d64616b5314a823eb3285328

  - it: hashes an operator-supplied PD Secret by its resourceVersion only
    template: pd-statefulset.yaml
    set:
      pd.auth.existingSecret: [REDACTED]
    asserts:
      - equal:
          path: spec.template.metadata.annotations["checksum/pd-auth"]
          value: c59f1600408fcc703d7ba56aafaa1a3154380c4c9f97f422a603f79139661ec3

  - it: keeps the generated PD value in the Secret and out of the annotation
    template: pd-statefulset.yaml
    asserts:
      - notMatchRegex:
          path: spec.template.metadata.annotations["checksum/pd-auth"]
          pattern: "pd-secret-steady|cGQtc2VjcmV0LXN0ZWFkeQ=="

  - it: hashes both live generated Server Secrets by value
    template: server-deployment.yaml
    asserts:
      - equal:
          path: spec.template.metadata.annotations["checksum/auth"]
          value: d5e9d6f7d7bdafc092bd65571b124c37b6aefdf5af871a1b5c4f999131e6e329

  - it: mixes an operator-supplied admin Secret resourceVersion with the generated token digest
    template: server-deployment.yaml
    set:
      server.auth.admin.existingSecret: byo-admin
    asserts:
      - equal:
          path: spec.template.metadata.annotations["checksum/auth"]
          value: 36d51dce49f4d417c0bad64d99f128a4f7498633dba0486ad6eb432c61196f0d

name: "HugeGraph-Commons CI"

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      java-versions:
        type: string
        required: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build-commons:
    timeout-minutes: 20
    name: Commons tests (Java ${{ matrix.JAVA_VERSION }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    env:
      USE_STAGE: 'false' # Whether to include the stage repository.
      TRAVIS_DIR: hugegraph-server/hugegraph-dist/src/assembly/travis

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        JAVA_VERSION: ${{ fromJSON(inputs.java-versions) }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2

      - name: Install JDK ${{ matrix.JAVA_VERSION }}
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          java-version: ${{ matrix.JAVA_VERSION }}
          distribution: 'zulu'
          cache: maven
          cache-jdk: false

      - name: Use staged maven repo settings
        if: ${{ env.USE_STAGE == 'true' }}
        run: |
          cp "$HOME/.m2/settings.xml" /tmp/settings.xml
          cp -vf .github/configs/settings.xml "$HOME/.m2/settings.xml" && cat "$HOME/.m2/settings.xml"

      - name: Install
        run: |
          mvn install -pl hugegraph-commons/hugegraph-common,hugegraph-commons/hugegraph-rpc -am \
            -Dmaven.javadoc.skip=true -ntp -Dmaven.test.skip=true

      - name: Run common test
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          RUNTIME_LOG=$(mktemp "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-runtime.XXXXXX")
          mvn test -pl hugegraph-commons/hugegraph-common -Dtest=UnitTestSuite \
            -DskipCommonsTests=false -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=true 2>&1 | tee "$RUNTIME_LOG"
          bash "$TRAVIS_DIR/check-java-runtime-logs.sh" "$RUNTIME_LOG"

      - name: Run rpc test
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          RUNTIME_LOG=$(mktemp "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-runtime.XXXXXX")
          mvn test -pl hugegraph-commons/hugegraph-rpc -Dtest=UnitTestSuite \
            -DskipCommonsTests=false -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=true 2>&1 | tee "$RUNTIME_LOG"
          bash "$TRAVIS_DIR/check-java-runtime-logs.sh" "$RUNTIME_LOG"

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: hugegraph-commons/target/jacoco.xml
          flags: commons
          disable_search: true
          fail_ci_if_error: false

name: "3rd-party"

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      submit-baseline:
        type: boolean
        default: false
      check-inventory:
        type: boolean
        default: true
    outputs:
      artifact_id:
        value: ${{ jobs.dependency-check.outputs.artifact_id }}
      inventory_artifact_id:
        value: ${{ jobs.dependency-check.outputs.inventory_artifact_id }}

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  dependency-check:
    name: dependency-check
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    # Preserve the existing inventory job budget; baseline-only builds keep their 60-minute limit.
    timeout-minutes: ${{ inputs.check-inventory && 360 || 60 }}
    outputs:
      artifact_id: ${{ steps.snapshot.outputs.artifact-id }}
      inventory_artifact_id: ${{ steps.inventory.outputs.artifact-id }}
    env:
      USE_STAGE: 'false' # Whether to include the stage repository.
      SCRIPT_DEPENDENCY: install-dist/scripts/dependency
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1' # Keep generated Python caches out of source style checks.
      INPUT_TOKEN: ''
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ''
      GH_TOKEN: ''
    steps:
      - name: Checkout source
        id: checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up project JDK
        uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6 # v6.0.1
        with:
          java-version-file: .github/workflows/.java-version
          distribution: 'temurin'
          cache: maven

      - name: use staged maven repo settings
        if: ${{ env.USE_STAGE == 'true' }}
        run: |
          cp "$HOME/.m2/settings.xml" /tmp/settings.xml
          mv -vf .github/configs/settings.xml "$HOME/.m2/settings.xml"

      - name: Test shared foundation checks
        if: inputs.check-inventory
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s install-dist/scripts/shared-foundation -p 'test_*.py'

      - name: Test dependency inventory producer and checker
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s install-dist/scripts/dependency -p 'test_*.py'

      - name: Verify baseline checkout and current master
        if: inputs.submit-baseline
        env:
          EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_SHA"
          test "$(git ls-remote origin refs/heads/master | cut -f1)" = "$EXPECTED_SHA"

      - name: mvn install
        env:
          CHECK_INVENTORY: ${{ inputs.check-inventory }}
        run: |
          args=(-Dmaven.test.skip=true -ntp --fail-at-end)
          if [[ "$CHECK_INVENTORY" != 'true' ]]; then
            args+=(-Dmaven.javadoc.skip=true)
          fi
          mvn install "${args[@]}"
      - name: Check shared foundation boundaries and shipped classes
        if: inputs.check-inventory
        run: |
          REVISION=$(mvn help:evaluate -Dexpression=project.version -q -DforceStdout)
          python3 install-dist/scripts/shared-foundation/check_shared_foundation.py --revision "$REVISION"

      - name: generate current dependencies
        if: inputs.check-inventory
        run: |
          bash "$SCRIPT_DEPENDENCY/regenerate_known_dependencies.sh" "$PWD/target/dependency/current-dependencies.txt"
      - name: check third dependencies
        if: inputs.check-inventory
        run: |
          bash "$SCRIPT_DEPENDENCY/check_dependencies.sh" \
            "$SCRIPT_DEPENDENCY/known-dependencies.txt" "$PWD/target/dependency/current-dependencies.txt"

      - name: Generate resolved reactor snapshot
        if: inputs.submit-baseline
        run: |
          mvn -B -ntp com.github.ferstl:depgraph-maven-plugin:4.0.3:graph \
            -DgraphFormat=json -DoutputFileName=maven-dependency-submission-action-depgraph.json \
            -Dmaven.test.skip=true -Dmaven.javadoc.skip=true
          python3 .github/scripts/dependency-snapshot.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/snapshot.json"
      - name: Resolve independent dependency inventory
        if: inputs.submit-baseline
        run: |

name: "Docker Build CI"

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      smoke-only:
        type: boolean
        default: false
permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  docker-build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    env:
      IMAGE_TAG: ci-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
      SOURCE_REVISION: ${{ github.sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        id: checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install project JDK for deployment contracts
        id: java
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.checkout.outcome == 'success' && !inputs.smoke-only }}
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          java-version-file: .github/workflows/.java-version
          distribution: 'zulu'
          cache: maven
          cache-jdk: false

      - name: Verify shared Maven stages stay identical
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.checkout.outcome == 'success' && !inputs.smoke-only }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          extract_build_stage() {
            awk '
              /^FROM .* AS build$/ {
                in_build = 1
              }
              in_build && seen && /^FROM / {
                exit
              }
              in_build {
                print
                seen = 1
              }
            ' "$1"
          }

          reference="hugegraph-pd/Dockerfile"
          if [ -z "$(extract_build_stage "$reference")" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: no 'AS build' stage found in $reference"
            exit 1
          fi
          for dockerfile in \
            hugegraph-store/Dockerfile \
            hugegraph-server/Dockerfile \
            hugegraph-server/Dockerfile-hstore; do
            diff -u \
              <(extract_build_stage "$reference") \
              <(extract_build_stage "$dockerfile")
          done

      - name: Validate shared image build graph
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.checkout.outcome == 'success' && !inputs.smoke-only }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          docker buildx bake --file docker/bake.hcl --print > /tmp/hugegraph-bake.json
          jq -e '
            .group.default.targets == [
              "build-cache",
              "pd",
              "server-hstore",
              "server-standalone",
              "store"
            ] and
            ([.target[] | .platforms] |
              all(. == ["linux/amd64", "linux/arm64"])) and
            .target["build-cache"].target == "build" and
            .target["build-cache"].output[0].type == "cacheonly" and
            ([.target | to_entries[] |
              select(.key != "build-cache") |
              .value.output[0].type] |
              all(. == "docker"))
          ' /tmp/hugegraph-bake.json

      - name: Verify deployment shell and Compose contracts
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.checkout.outcome == 'success' && steps.java.outcome == 'success' }}
        timeout-minutes: 25
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          status=0
          if mvn -B -ntp -pl hugegraph-commons/hugegraph-common -am clean compile dependency:build-classpath \
              -Dmdep.outputFile=target/config-readback-classpath.txt -Dmaven.javadoc.skip=true -DskipTests; then
            HG_CONFIG_TEST_CLASSPATH="$PWD/hugegraph-commons/hugegraph-common/target/classes"
            HG_CONFIG_TEST_CLASSPATH+=":$(cat hugegraph-commons/hugegraph-common/target/config-readback-classpath.txt)"
            export HG_CONFIG_TEST_CLASSPATH
            if ! bash hugegraph-server/hugegraph-dist/docker/docker-entrypoint-test.sh; then
              status=1
            fi
          else
            status=1
          fi
          if ! bash hugegraph-server/hugegraph-dist/docker/test/test-docker-entrypoint.sh; then
            status=1
          fi
          if ! bash hugegraph-server/hugegraph-dist/src/assembly/travis/test-check-port.sh \
              hugegraph-server/hugegraph-dist/src/assembly/static \
              hugegraph-store/hg-store-dist/src/assembly/static/bin/util.sh; then
            status=1
          fi
          if ! bash docker/test-compose.sh render; then
            status=1
          fi
          exit "$status"

      - name: Build current images and verify authentication, readiness and graph read/write
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.checkout.outcome == 'success' }}
        timeout-minutes: 45
        env:
          SMOKE_ONLY: ${{ inputs.smoke-only }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          docker buildx create --driver docker-container --use
          docker buildx bake --file docker/bake.hcl --progress=plain \
            --set '*.platform=linux/amd64' \
            pd store server-standalone server-hstore

          # Each runtime check uses successfully built images. Preserve a failed
          # check while allowing the independent deployment check to collect results.
          status=0
          if ! bash .github/scripts/check-docker-images.sh; then
            status=1
          fi
          if [[ "$SMOKE_ONLY" != true ]]; then
            if ! python3 -m unittest discover -s .github/scripts -p 'test_docker_deployment.py'; then
              status=1
            fi
          fi
          if ! python3 .github/scripts/docker-deployment.py "$IMAGE_TAG"; then
            status=1
          fi
          exit "$status"

          "$TRAVIS_DIR/run-native-runtime-smoke-test.sh" "$SERVER_DIR"

      - name: Run RocksDB core test
        if: inputs.macos-full
        run: |
          "$TRAVIS_DIR/run-core-test.sh" "$BACKEND"

          SERVER_DIR="hugegraph-server/apache-hugegraph-server-$VERSION"

            tail -n 200 "$SERVER_DIR/logs/hugegraph-server.log"

      - name: Stop RocksDB server
        if: always()
        run: |
          VERSION=$(mvn help:evaluate -Dexpression=project.version -q -DforceStdout)
          SERVER_DIR="hugegraph-server/apache-hugegraph-server-$VERSION"
          if [ -f "$SERVER_DIR/bin/pid" ]; then

name: Dependency baseline submission

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      artifact-id:
        required: true
        type: string
      inventory-artifact-id:
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  submit:
    if: >-
      ((github.repository == 'apache/hugegraph' && github.event.repository.fork == false) ||
       github.repository == 'hugegraph/hugegraph') &&
      github.ref == 'refs/heads/master' &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: write
      actions: read
    steps:
      - name: Validate and submit snapshot data
        env:
          SNAPSHOT_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EXPECTED_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
          RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}
          ARTIFACT_ID: ${{ inputs.artifact-id }}
          INVENTORY_ARTIFACT_ID: ${{ inputs.inventory-artifact-id }}
        run: |
          python3 -I - <<'PY'
          import datetime
          import hashlib
          import io
          import json
          import os
          import re
          import stat
          import urllib.error
          import urllib.parse
          import urllib.request
          import zipfile

          LIMIT = 25 * 1024 * 1024

          def require(condition, message):
              if not condition:
                  raise ValueError(message)

          def unique_object(pairs):
              result = {}
              for key, value in pairs:
                  require(key not in result, 'Duplicate JSON key')
                  result[key] = value
              return result

          class NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler):
              def redirect_request(self, *args, **kwargs):
                  return None

          def github_request(repository, path, data=None):
              return urllib.request.Request('https://api.github.com/repos/' + repository + '/' + path,
                  data=None if data is None else json.dumps(data).encode(),
                  headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + os.environ['SNAPSHOT_TOKEN'],
                           'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json', 'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                           'X-GitHub-Api-Version': '2022-11-28'})

          def bounded_body(response):
              raw = response.read(LIMIT + 1)
              require(len(raw) <= LIMIT, 'Response too large')
              return raw

          def api(repository, path, data=None):
              request = github_request(repository, path, data)
              with urllib.request.build_opener(NoRedirect()).open(request, timeout=60) as response:
                  require(response.status == (200 if data is None else 201), 'Unexpected API status')
                  raw = bounded_body(response)
              return json.loads(raw, object_pairs_hook=unique_object)

          def read_snapshot(raw, member_name='snapshot.json'):
              require(0 < len(raw) <= LIMIT, 'Invalid ZIP size')
              with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(raw)) as archive:
                  members = archive.infolist()
                  require(len(members) == 1, 'ZIP must contain one data file')
                  member = members[0]
                  require(member.orig_filename == member_name and not member.is_dir() and
                          not (member.external_attr & 0x10) and
                          stat.S_IFMT(member.external_attr >> 16) in [0, stat.S_IFREG] and
                          not (member.flag_bits & 1) and
                          member.compress_type in [zipfile.ZIP_STORED, zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED] and
                          0 < member.file_size <= LIMIT, 'Invalid ZIP member')
                  with archive.open(member) as stream:
                      payload = bounded_body(stream)
                  require(len(payload) == member.file_size, 'Incomplete ZIP member')
              return json.loads(payload, object_pairs_hook=unique_object)

          def download_snapshot(repository, artifact_id, artifact, member_name='snapshot.json'):
              opener = urllib.request.build_opener(NoRedirect())
              try:
                  response = opener.open(github_request(repository, f'actions/artifacts/{artifact_id}/zip'), timeout=60)
              except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
                  require(error.code == 302, 'Expected artifact redirect')
                  location = error.headers.get('Location', '')
                  error.close()
              else:
                  response.close()
                  raise ValueError('Expected artifact redirect')
              target = urllib.parse.urlsplit(location)
              require(target.scheme == 'https' and target.hostname and
                      target.hostname.endswith(('.blob.core.windows.net', '.githubusercontent.com')) and
                      target.username is None and target.password is None and
                      target.port in [None, 443] and not target.fragment, 'Invalid artifact redirect')
              # A separate request carries no GitHub Authorization to blob storage.
              with opener.open(urllib.request.Request(location), timeout=60) as response:
                  require(response.status == 200, 'Artifact download failed')
                  raw = bounded_body(response)
              require(len(raw) == artifact['size_in_bytes'] and
                      'sha256:' + hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == artifact['digest'], 'Artifact digest/size mismatch')
              return read_snapshot(raw, member_name)

          def timestamp(value):
              parsed = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
              require(parsed.tzinfo is not None, 'Timestamp lacks timezone')
              return parsed

          def main():
              repository, sha = os.environ['EXPECTED_REPOSITORY'], os.environ['EXPECTED_SHA']
              run_id, attempt, artifact_id = (os.environ[key] for key in ['RUN_ID', 'RUN_ATTEMPT', 'ARTIFACT_ID'])
              require(repository in ['apache/hugegraph', 'hugegraph/hugegraph'], 'Repository refused')
              require(re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}', sha), 'Invalid commit')
              require(all(re.fullmatch('[1-9][0-9]*', x) for x in [run_id, attempt, artifact_id]), 'Invalid ID')
              run = api(repository, f'actions/runs/{run_id}/attempts/{attempt}')
              require(run['id'] == int(run_id) and run['run_attempt'] == int(attempt) and
                      run['head_sha'] == sha and run['head_branch'] == 'master' and
                      run['event'] in ['push', 'workflow_dispatch'] and
                      run['repository']['full_name'] == repository and
                      run['path'] in ['.github/workflows/server-ci.yml',
                                      '.github/workflows/server-ci.yml@master'], 'Run identity')
              jobs = api(repository, f'actions/runs/{run_id}/attempts/{attempt}/jobs?per_page=100')
              require(jobs['total_count'] <= 100, 'Too many jobs')
              producers = [job for job in jobs['jobs'] if job['name'] == 'dependency_license / dependency-check']
              require(len(producers) == 1 and producers[0]['conclusion'] == 'success' and
                      producers[0]['status'] == 'completed' and producers[0]['run_id'] == int(run_id) and
                      producers[0]['head_sha'] == sha, 'Producer did not succeed for this commit')
              inventory_id = os.environ['INVENTORY_ARTIFACT_ID']
              require(re.fullmatch('[1-9][0-9]*', inventory_id) and inventory_id != artifact_id, 'Inventory ID')

              def checked_artifact(identifier, kind):
                  item = api(repository, f'actions/artifacts/{identifier}')
                  require(item['id'] == int(identifier) and item['expired'] is False and
                          item['name'] == f'dependency-{kind}-{run_id}-{attempt}' and
                          item['workflow_run']['id'] == int(run_id) and item['workflow_run']['head_sha'] == sha and
                          item['workflow_run']['head_branch'] == 'master' and
                          type(item['size_in_bytes']) is int and 0 < item['size_in_bytes'] <= LIMIT and
                          isinstance(item['digest'], str) and re.fullmatch('sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}', item['digest']),
                          'Artifact identity')
                  return item

              artifact = checked_artifact(artifact_id, 'snapshot')
              inventory_artifact = checked_artifact(inventory_id, 'inventory')
              snapshot = download_snapshot(repository, artifact_id, artifact)
              require(isinstance(snapshot, dict) and set(snapshot) ==
                      {'version', 'sha', 'ref', 'job', 'detector', 'metadata', 'scanned', 'manifests'}, 'Snapshot schema')
              require(type(snapshot['version']) is int and snapshot['version'] == 0 and
                      snapshot['sha'] == sha and snapshot['ref'] == 'refs/heads/master', 'Snapshot source')
              require(snapshot['job'] == {'id': run_id,
                      'correlator': '.github/workflows/submit-dependencies.yml:submit',
                      'html_url': f'https://github.com/{repository}/actions/runs/{run_id}'}, 'Snapshot job')
              require(snapshot['detector'] == {'name': 'maven-dependency-submission-action', 'version': '6.0.1',
                      'url': 'https://github.com/advanced-security/maven-dependency-submission-action'}, 'Detector')
              require(snapshot['metadata'] == {'serializer':
                      'Ferstl 4.0.3; repository stdlib adapter for Maven parser 6.0.1',
                      'producer': 'generate', 'run_attempt': attempt}, 'Producer identity')
              now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc) + datetime.timedelta(minutes=1)
              require(timestamp(run['run_started_at']) <= timestamp(snapshot['scanned']) <=
                      timestamp(artifact['created_at']) + datetime.timedelta(minutes=1) and
                      timestamp(artifact['created_at']) <= now and timestamp(snapshot['scanned']) <= now,
                      'Snapshot freshness')
              inventory = download_snapshot(repository, inventory_id, inventory_artifact, 'inventory.json')
              require(isinstance(inventory, dict) and set(inventory) ==
                      {'version', 'sha', 'repository', 'run_id', 'run_attempt', 'producer', 'resolver',
                       'scanned', 'manifests'}, 'Inventory schema')
              require(type(inventory['version']) is int and inventory['version'] == 1 and
                      inventory['sha'] == sha and inventory['repository'] == repository and
                      inventory['run_id'] == run_id and inventory['run_attempt'] == attempt and
                      inventory['producer'] == 'inventory' and inventory['resolver'] ==
                      'org.apache.maven.plugins:maven-dependency-plugin:3.8.1:tree', 'Inventory source')
              require(timestamp(run['run_started_at']) <= timestamp(inventory['scanned']) <=
                      timestamp(inventory_artifact['created_at']) + datetime.timedelta(minutes=1) and
                      timestamp(inventory_artifact['created_at']) <= now and timestamp(inventory['scanned']) <= now,
                      'Inventory freshness')
              tree = api(repository, f'git/trees/{sha}?recursive=1')
              require(tree['truncated'] is False, 'Incomplete source tree')
              poms = {node['path'] for node in tree['tree'] if node['type'] == 'blob' and
                      node['path'].split('/')[-1] == 'pom.xml' and node['mode'] != '120000'}
              require(isinstance(inventory['manifests'], dict) and set(inventory['manifests']) == poms,
                      'Incomplete independent inventory')
              manifests, paths = snapshot['manifests'], set()
              require(isinstance(manifests, dict) and manifests and poms, 'Empty inventory')
              component = r"(?:[A-Za-z0-9._!~*'():+-]|%[0-9A-F]{2})+"
              qualifier = r'(?:[A-Za-z0-9._*\-]|%[0-9A-F]{2})+'
              purl_pattern = (r'pkg:maven/' + component + '(?:/' + component + ')+@' + component +
                              r'(?:\?classifier=' + qualifier + '(?:&type=' + qualifier + r')?|\?type=' + qualifier + ')?')
              for name, manifest in manifests.items():
                  require(isinstance(name, str) and name.strip() and isinstance(manifest, dict) and
                          set(manifest) == {'name', 'file', 'resolved'} and manifest['name'] == name and
                          isinstance(manifest['file'], dict) and set(manifest['file']) == {'source_location'},
                          'Manifest schema')
                  location = manifest['file']['source_location']
                  require(isinstance(location, str) and location in poms and location not in paths, 'Manifest source')
                  paths.add(location)
                  resolved = manifest['resolved']
                  require(isinstance(resolved, dict), 'Resolved schema')
                  for purl, package in resolved.items():
                      require(isinstance(purl, str) and len(purl) <= 4096 and
                              re.fullmatch(purl_pattern, purl), 'Package URL')
                      require(isinstance(package, dict) and set(package) ==
                              {'package_url', 'relationship', 'scope', 'dependencies'} and
                              package['package_url'] == purl and package['relationship'] in ['direct', 'indirect'] and
                              package['scope'] in ['runtime', 'development'] and
                              isinstance(package['dependencies'], list) and
                              all(isinstance(child, str) and child in resolved for child in package['dependencies']),
                              'Package schema')
                  require(not resolved or any(p['relationship'] == 'direct' for p in resolved.values()),
                          'Missing direct dependencies')
                  observed = {purl: {'scope': package['scope'], 'relationship': package['relationship']}
                              for purl, package in resolved.items()}
                  require(observed == inventory['manifests'][location], 'Dependency inventory mismatch')
              require(paths == poms and any(m['resolved'] for m in manifests.values()), 'Incomplete inventory')
              require(api(repository, 'git/ref/heads/master')['object']['sha'] == sha, 'Stale master before submission')
              result = api(repository, 'dependency-graph/snapshots', snapshot)
              require(result['result'] == 'SUCCESS', 'Snapshot not accepted')
              require(api(repository, 'git/ref/heads/master')['object']['sha'] == sha, 'Master advanced during submission')

      - name: Check RocksDB version compatibility
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && !inputs.run-pd }}
        uses: ./.github/actions/rocksdb-compatibility

      # Upload last: Codecov downloads unlicensed checksum files into the workspace.
      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.store-coverage.outcome == 'success' }}
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: ${{ env.REPORT_FILE }}
          flags: store
          disable_search: true
          fail_ci_if_error: false

  hstore:
    if: inputs.run-hstore
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    env:
      USE_STAGE: 'false' # Whether to include the stage repository.
      TRAVIS_DIR: hugegraph-server/hugegraph-dist/src/assembly/travis
      REPORT_DIR: target/site/jacoco
      BACKEND: hstore
      # Long TP suites run only on dedicated validation branches.
      RUN_TINKERPOP_TESTS: >-
        ${{
          startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release-') ||
          startsWith(github.ref_name, 'test-') ||
          startsWith(github.ref_name, 'tinkerpop-') ||
          startsWith(github.head_ref, 'release-') ||
          startsWith(github.head_ref, 'test-') ||
          startsWith(github.head_ref, 'tinkerpop-') ||
          startsWith(github.base_ref, 'release-') ||
          startsWith(github.base_ref, 'test-') ||
          startsWith(github.base_ref, 'tinkerpop-')
        }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2

      - name: Install project JDK
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          java-version-file: .github/workflows/.java-version
          distribution: 'zulu'
          cache: maven
          cache-jdk: false

      - name: use staged maven repo settings
        if: ${{ env.USE_STAGE == 'true' }}
        run: |
          cp $HOME/.m2/settings.xml /tmp/settings.xml
          mv -vf .github/configs/settings.xml $HOME/.m2/settings.xml

      - name: Package
        # todo remove --fail-at-end after test
        run: |
          mvn clean package -U -Dmaven.javadoc.skip=true -Dmaven.test.skip=true -ntp --fail-at-end

      - name: Prepare env and service
        run: |
          VERSION=$(grep -E '^VersionInBash=' \
            hugegraph-commons/hugegraph-common/src/main/resources/version.properties | cut -d'=' -f2-)
          [[ "$VERSION" =~ ^[0-9A-Za-z._-]+$ ]] || {
            echo "Invalid VersionInBash: $VERSION"
            exit 1
          }
          STORE_CONFIG=hugegraph-store/apache-hugegraph-store-$VERSION/conf/application-pd.yml
          [[ -f "$STORE_CONFIG" ]] || {
            echo "Store config not found: $STORE_CONFIG"
            exit 1
          }
          [[ $(grep -Ec '^[[:space:]]*min_write_buffer_number_to_merge:' \
                       "$STORE_CONFIG") -eq 1 ]] || {
            echo "Unable to locate RocksDB config insertion point: $STORE_CONFIG"
            exit 1
          }
          # Bound file-handle caching for this CI topology without changing
          # the released Store default for deployments with different limits.
          sed -i \
            -e '/^[[:space:]]*max_open_files:/d' \
            -e '/^[[:space:]]*min_write_buffer_number_to_merge:/a\  max_open_files: 4096' \
            "$STORE_CONFIG"
          grep -n 'max_open_files' "$STORE_CONFIG"

          SOFT_OPEN_FILES=$(ulimit -Sn)
          echo "[ci] open-file limit before HStore startup:" \
               "soft=$SOFT_OPEN_FILES, hard=$(ulimit -Hn)"
          if [[ "$SOFT_OPEN_FILES" != "unlimited" ]] &&
             (( SOFT_OPEN_FILES < 65535 )); then
            ulimit -Sn 65535
          fi
          echo "[ci] open-file limit for HStore:" \
               "soft=$(ulimit -Sn), hard=$(ulimit -Hn)"
          $TRAVIS_DIR/install-backend.sh $BACKEND
          VERSION=$(mvn help:evaluate -Dexpression=project.version -q -DforceStdout)
          echo "PD_DIR=hugegraph-pd/apache-hugegraph-pd-$VERSION" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "STORE_DIR=hugegraph-store/apache-hugegraph-store-$VERSION" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Run unit test
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          RUNTIME_LOG=$(mktemp "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-runtime.XXXXXX")
          $TRAVIS_DIR/run-unit-test.sh $BACKEND 2>&1 | tee "$RUNTIME_LOG"
          bash "$TRAVIS_DIR/check-java-runtime-logs.sh" "$RUNTIME_LOG" "$PD_DIR/logs" "$STORE_DIR/logs"

      - name: Run core test
        # Bound stuck HStore scans so the diagnostic steps below can run
        # before the GitHub-hosted job reaches its global execution limit.
        timeout-minutes: 45
        env:
          HUGEGRAPH_TEST_TASK_LOG_LEVEL: WARN
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          RUNTIME_LOG=$(mktemp "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-runtime.XXXXXX")
          $TRAVIS_DIR/run-core-test.sh $BACKEND 2>&1 | tee "$RUNTIME_LOG"
          bash "$TRAVIS_DIR/check-java-runtime-logs.sh" "$RUNTIME_LOG" "$PD_DIR/logs" "$STORE_DIR/logs"

      - name: Run api test
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          RUNTIME_LOG=$(mktemp "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-runtime.XXXXXX")
          $TRAVIS_DIR/run-api-test.sh $BACKEND $REPORT_DIR 2>&1 | tee "$RUNTIME_LOG"
          bash "$TRAVIS_DIR/check-java-runtime-logs.sh" "$RUNTIME_LOG" "$PD_DIR/logs" "$STORE_DIR/logs"

      - name: Run raft test
        if: ${{ env.BACKEND == 'rocksdb' }}
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          RUNTIME_LOG=$(mktemp "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-runtime.XXXXXX")
          $TRAVIS_DIR/run-api-test-for-raft.sh $BACKEND $REPORT_DIR 2>&1 | tee "$RUNTIME_LOG"
          bash "$TRAVIS_DIR/check-java-runtime-logs.sh" "$RUNTIME_LOG" "$PD_DIR/logs" "$STORE_DIR/logs"

      # Include HStore in the upgrade compatibility gate. The dedicated HStore
      # service setup above makes its structure/process suites exercise the
      # distributed backend rather than only the memory and RocksDB paths.
      - name: Run TinkerPop structure test
        if: ${{ env.RUN_TINKERPOP_TESTS == 'true' }}
        # The HStore suite needs close to one hour before global cleanup, so
        # keep enough headroom to finish cleanup and emit Surefire results.
        timeout-minutes: 120
        env:
          HUGEGRAPH_TEST_TASK_LOG_LEVEL: WARN
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          RUNTIME_LOG=$(mktemp "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-runtime.XXXXXX")
          # Emit lightweight samples during execution: a lost runner cannot
          # upload the failure-only diagnostics below.
          python3 - "$TRAVIS_DIR/run-tinkerpop-test.sh" "$BACKEND" structure 2>&1 <<'PYTHON' | tee "$RUNTIME_LOG"
          import datetime
          import os
          import pathlib
          import subprocess
          import sys

          with subprocess.Popen(sys.argv[1:]) as test:
              while test.poll() is None:
                  try:
                      print("[hstore-resources] " + datetime.datetime.now(
                          datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(), flush=True)
                      subprocess.run(["free", "-m"], check=False)
                      processes = subprocess.run(
                          ["ps", "-eo", "pid,comm,rss,pcpu", "--sort=-rss"],
                          capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
                      print("\n".join(processes.stdout.splitlines()[:12]), flush=True)
                      for name in ("/proc/pressure/memory", "/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.events"):
                          path = pathlib.Path(name)
                          if path.is_file():
                              try:
                                  print(f"{name}: {path.read_text().strip()}", flush=True)
                              except OSError:
                                  pass
                      java = subprocess.run(["pgrep", "-x", "java"],
                                            capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
                      for pid in java.stdout.split():
                          try:
                              with os.scandir(f"/proc/{pid}/fd") as entries:
                                  count = sum(1 for _ in entries)
                              print(f"java pid={pid} open_fds={count}", flush=True)
                          except OSError:
                              pass
                  except (OSError, UnicodeError) as error:
                      print(f"[hstore-resources] sampling unavailable: {error}", flush=True)
                  try:
                      result = test.wait(timeout=60)
                      sys.exit(result if result >= 0 else 128 - result)
                  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                      pass
              result = test.returncode
              sys.exit(result if result >= 0 else 128 - result)
          PYTHON
          bash "$TRAVIS_DIR/check-java-runtime-logs.sh" "$RUNTIME_LOG" "$PD_DIR/logs" "$STORE_DIR/logs"

      - name: Run TinkerPop process standard test
        if: ${{ env.RUN_TINKERPOP_TESTS == 'true' }}
        timeout-minutes: 120
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          RUNTIME_LOG=$(mktemp "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-runtime.XXXXXX")
          $TRAVIS_DIR/run-tinkerpop-test.sh $BACKEND process-standard 2>&1 | tee "$RUNTIME_LOG"
          bash "$TRAVIS_DIR/check-java-runtime-logs.sh" "$RUNTIME_LOG" "$PD_DIR/logs" "$STORE_DIR/logs"

      - name: Run TinkerPop process feature test
        if: ${{ env.RUN_TINKERPOP_TESTS == 'true' }}
        timeout-minutes: 120
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          RUNTIME_LOG=$(mktemp "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-runtime.XXXXXX")
          $TRAVIS_DIR/run-tinkerpop-test.sh $BACKEND process-feature 2>&1 | tee "$RUNTIME_LOG"
          bash "$TRAVIS_DIR/check-java-runtime-logs.sh" "$RUNTIME_LOG" "$PD_DIR/logs" "$STORE_DIR/logs"

      - name: Collect HStore diagnostics on failure or timeout
        if: ${{ failure() || cancelled() }}
        timeout-minutes: 10
        run: |
          set +e
          DIAGNOSTICS_DIR=hstore-diagnostics
          mkdir -p "$DIAGNOSTICS_DIR/threads" \
                   "$DIAGNOSTICS_DIR/surefire" \
                   "$DIAGNOSTICS_DIR/services"
          exec > >(tee -a "$DIAGNOSTICS_DIR/summary.log") 2>&1

          VERSION=$(grep -E '^VersionInBash=' \
            hugegraph-commons/hugegraph-common/src/main/resources/version.properties | cut -d'=' -f2-)
          [[ "$VERSION" =~ ^[0-9A-Za-z._-]+$ ]] || {
            echo "Invalid VersionInBash: $VERSION"
            exit 0
          }
          PD_DIR=hugegraph-pd/apache-hugegraph-pd-$VERSION
          STORE_DIR=hugegraph-store/apache-hugegraph-store-$VERSION
          SERVER_DIR=hugegraph-server/apache-hugegraph-server-$VERSION

          echo "::group::HugeGraphStore file descriptors"
          STORE_PID_FILE="$STORE_DIR/bin/pid"
          if [[ -f "$STORE_PID_FILE" ]]; then
            STORE_PID=$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "$STORE_PID_FILE")
            if [[ "$STORE_PID" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] &&
               [[ -r "/proc/$STORE_PID/limits" ]] &&
               [[ -d "/proc/$STORE_PID/fd" ]]; then
              cat "/proc/$STORE_PID/limits" |
                tee "$DIAGNOSTICS_DIR/services/store-process-limits.txt" || true

              FD_TARGETS="$DIAGNOSTICS_DIR/services/store-fd-targets.txt"
              find "/proc/$STORE_PID/fd" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type l \
                -printf '%l\n' >"$FD_TARGETS" \
                2>"$DIAGNOSTICS_DIR/services/store-fd-errors.txt" || true
              ls -l "/proc/$STORE_PID/fd" \
                >"$DIAGNOSTICS_DIR/services/store-fds.txt" 2>&1 || true

              STORE_FD_COUNT=$(wc -l < "$FD_TARGETS" | tr -d '[:space:]')
              echo "[ci] Store PID $STORE_PID open fd count: $STORE_FD_COUNT" |
                tee "$DIAGNOSTICS_DIR/services/store-fd-count.txt" || true

              awk '
                /\.sst/ { types["rocksdb-sst"]++; next }
                /^socket:/ { types["socket"]++; next }
                /^pipe:/ { types["pipe"]++; next }
                /^anon_inode:/ { types["anon-inode"]++; next }
                /\/storage\// { types["rocksdb-other"]++; next }
                { types["other"]++ }
                END {
                  for (type in types) {
                    print types[type], type
                  }
                }
              ' "$FD_TARGETS" | sort -nr |
                tee "$DIAGNOSTICS_DIR/services/store-fd-types.txt" || true

              sort "$FD_TARGETS" | uniq -c | sort -nr \
                >"$DIAGNOSTICS_DIR/services/store-fd-target-counts.txt" || true
              echo "[ci] Store top fd targets:"
              head -n 50 \
                "$DIAGNOSTICS_DIR/services/store-fd-target-counts.txt" || true
            else
              echo "[ci] Store PID is unavailable for fd diagnostics: $STORE_PID"
            fi
          else
            echo "[ci] Store pid file not found: $STORE_PID_FILE"
          fi
          echo "::endgroup::"

          echo "::group::Runner process snapshot"
          ps -eo pid,ppid,stat,etime,%cpu,%mem,args --sort=pid |
            tee "$DIAGNOSTICS_DIR/processes.txt" || true
          (ss -ltnp || netstat -ltnp || true) 2>&1 |
            tee "$DIAGNOSTICS_DIR/listening-ports.txt" || true
          echo "::endgroup::"

          echo "::group::Java thread dumps"
          if command -v jcmd >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            jcmd -l | tee "$DIAGNOSTICS_DIR/jcmd-list.txt" || true
            while read -r pid _; do
              [[ "$pid" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || continue
              kill -0 "$pid" >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue
              thread_dump="$DIAGNOSTICS_DIR/threads/java-$pid.txt"
              timeout 30s jcmd "$pid" Thread.print -l >"$thread_dump" 2>&1
              if [[ $? -ne 0 ]] && command -v jstack >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                timeout 30s jstack -l "$pid" >"$thread_dump" 2>&1 || true
              fi
              echo "[ci] captured Java thread dump: $thread_dump"
            done < "$DIAGNOSTICS_DIR/jcmd-list.txt"
          else
            echo "[ci] jcmd is unavailable"
          fi
          echo "::endgroup::"

          bash $TRAVIS_DIR/ci-service-utils.sh dump "$PD_DIR" HugeGraphPD || true
          bash $TRAVIS_DIR/ci-service-utils.sh dump "$STORE_DIR" HugeGraphStore || true
          bash $TRAVIS_DIR/ci-service-utils.sh dump \
            "$SERVER_DIR" HugeGraphServer || true

          for service in \
            "pd:$PD_DIR/logs" \
            "store:$STORE_DIR/logs" \
            "server:$SERVER_DIR/logs"; do
            service_name="${service%%:*}"
            log_dir="${service#*:}"
            if [[ -d "$log_dir" ]]; then
              mkdir -p "$DIAGNOSTICS_DIR/services/$service_name"
              # Skip heap dumps (logs/heapdump_*/): they can be gigabytes.
              tar -C "$log_dir" --exclude='*.hprof*' -cf - . | \
                tar -C "$DIAGNOSTICS_DIR/services/$service_name" -xf - || true
            fi
          done

          echo "::group::Surefire reports"
          while read -r report; do
            destination="$DIAGNOSTICS_DIR/surefire/${report#./}"
            mkdir -p "$(dirname "$destination")"
            cp "$report" "$destination" || true
            echo "--- tail -n 200 $report ---"
            tail -n 200 "$report" || true
          done < <(
            find . -path "./$DIAGNOSTICS_DIR" -prune -o \
              -path '*/surefire-reports/*' -type f \
              \( -name '*.txt' -o -name '*.xml' -o \
                 -name '*.dump' -o -name '*.dumpstream' \) \
              -print | sort
          )
          echo "::endgroup::"
          exit 0

      - name: Upload HStore diagnostics
        if: ${{ failure() || cancelled() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: hstore-diagnostics-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: hstore-diagnostics
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: ${{ env.REPORT_DIR }}/*.xml
          flags: hstore
          disable_search: true
          fail_ci_if_error: false

      # The first selected distributed job owns the shared compatibility check.
      - name: Check RocksDB version compatibility
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && !inputs.run-pd && !inputs.run-store }}
        uses: ./.github/actions/rocksdb-compatibility

name: "RISC-V Server CI"

on:
  workflow_call:

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  BINFMT_IMAGE: >-
    tonistiigi/binfmt@sha256:400a4873b838d1b89194d982c45e5fb3cda4593fbfd7e08a02e76b03b21166f0
  RISCV64_BASE_IMAGE: >-
    ubuntu@sha256:4edded5722eb644868b7b976033d241d2ab3fff0a170924df69b200a59a2b994
  TEMURIN_RISCV64_ARCHIVE: >-
    OpenJDK17U-jdk_riscv64_linux_hotspot_17.0.20_8.tar.gz
  TEMURIN_RISCV64_SHA256: >-
    bc36e8044c88df9f4ec2967c5277d1c8fae572378c12c0bac44dcae15d3af2f7
  TEMURIN_RISCV64_BASE_URL: >-
    https://github.com/adoptium/temurin17-binaries/releases/download
  TEMURIN_RISCV64_RELEASE: jdk-17.0.20%2B8
  EXPECTED_JAVA_MAJOR: '17'
  EXPECTED_RISCV64_JAVA_VERSION: '17.0.20'
  EXPECTED_RISCV64_JAVA_VENDOR: Eclipse Adoptium
  RISCV64_CONTAINER: >-
    hugegraph-riscv64-ci-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}

jobs:
  build-server-riscv64:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Start isolated RISC-V environment
        run: |
          docker run --privileged --rm "$BINFMT_IMAGE" --install riscv64
          docker run --detach --init --platform linux/riscv64 \
            --name "$RISCV64_CONTAINER" "$RISCV64_BASE_IMAGE" sleep infinity
          test "$(docker exec "$RISCV64_CONTAINER" uname -m)" = riscv64

      - name: Prepare source and Java 17
        run: |
          ARCHIVE_PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/$TEMURIN_RISCV64_ARCHIVE"
          curl --fail --location --retry 3 --show-error \
            "$TEMURIN_RISCV64_BASE_URL/$TEMURIN_RISCV64_RELEASE/$TEMURIN_RISCV64_ARCHIVE" \
            --output "$ARCHIVE_PATH"
          echo "$TEMURIN_RISCV64_SHA256  $ARCHIVE_PATH" | sha256sum -c -

          docker exec "$RISCV64_CONTAINER" mkdir -p /workspace /opt/temurin
          git ls-files -z | tar --null --files-from=- -cf - | \
            docker exec -i "$RISCV64_CONTAINER" tar -xf - -C /workspace
          docker cp "$ARCHIVE_PATH" \
            "$RISCV64_CONTAINER:/tmp/$TEMURIN_RISCV64_ARCHIVE"

      - name: Build and smoke test on RISC-V
        run: |
          docker exec \
            --env TEMURIN_RISCV64_ARCHIVE="$TEMURIN_RISCV64_ARCHIVE" \
            --env TEMURIN_RISCV64_SHA256="$TEMURIN_RISCV64_SHA256" \
            --env EXPECTED_JAVA_MAJOR="$EXPECTED_JAVA_MAJOR" \
            --env EXPECTED_RISCV64_JAVA_VERSION="$EXPECTED_RISCV64_JAVA_VERSION" \
            --env EXPECTED_RISCV64_JAVA_VENDOR="$EXPECTED_RISCV64_JAVA_VENDOR" \
            "$RISCV64_CONTAINER" bash -euo pipefail -c '
              test "$(uname -m)" = riscv64
              apt-get -q update
              apt-get -q install -y --no-install-recommends \
                ca-certificates curl jq libatomic1 libgcc-s1 libstdc++6 \
                lsof maven procps \
                protobuf-compiler protobuf-compiler-grpc-java-plugin

              ARCHIVE_PATH="/tmp/$TEMURIN_RISCV64_ARCHIVE"
              echo "$TEMURIN_RISCV64_SHA256  $ARCHIVE_PATH" | sha256sum -c -
              tar -xzf "$ARCHIVE_PATH" --strip-components=1 -C /opt/temurin
              rm "$ARCHIVE_PATH"
              export JAVA_HOME=/opt/temurin
              export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"

              java -XshowSettings:vm -version
              test -x /usr/bin/protoc
              test -x /usr/bin/grpc_java_plugin

              cd /workspace
              MAVEN_OPTS="-XX:TieredStopAtLevel=1 -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=2" \
                mvn clean package -B -ntp -Drocksdb-only \
                  -P riscv64-protobuf-tools \
                  -pl hugegraph-server/hugegraph-dist -am \
                  -Dmaven.test.skip=true -Dmaven.javadoc.skip=true
              hugegraph-server/hugegraph-dist/src/assembly/travis/check-rocksdb-only-dist.sh \
                hugegraph-server/apache-hugegraph-server-*/
              hugegraph-server/hugegraph-dist/src/assembly/travis/run-native-runtime-smoke-test.sh \
                hugegraph-server/apache-hugegraph-server-*/
            '

      - name: Show server log on failure
        if: failure()
        run: |
          if docker container inspect "$RISCV64_CONTAINER" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            docker exec "$RISCV64_CONTAINER" bash -c '
              find /workspace -path "*/logs/hugegraph-server.log" \
                -exec tail -n 200 {} \;
            ' || true
          fi

      - name: Clean up RISC-V environment
        if: always()
        run: |
          if docker container inspect "$RISCV64_CONTAINER" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            docker rm --force --volumes "$RISCV64_CONTAINER"
          fi
          if docker container inspect "$RISCV64_CONTAINER" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "RISC-V CI container still exists: $RISCV64_CONTAINER" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

name: Server backend tests

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      backend:
        type: string
        required: true
      java-versions:
        type: string
        required: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build-server:
    name: Server ${{ inputs.backend }} tests (Java ${{ matrix.JAVA_VERSION }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    env:
      USE_STAGE: 'false' # Whether to include the stage repository.
      TRAVIS_DIR: hugegraph-server/hugegraph-dist/src/assembly/travis
      REPORT_DIR: target/site/jacoco
      BACKEND: ${{ inputs.backend }}
      TRIGGER_BRANCH_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}
      HEAD_BRANCH_NAME: ${{ github.head_ref }}
      BASE_BRANCH_NAME: ${{ github.base_ref }}
      TARGET_BRANCH_NAME: ${{ github.base_ref != '' && github.base_ref || github.ref_name }}
      # Long TP suites run only on dedicated validation branches.
      RUN_TINKERPOP_TESTS: >-
        ${{
          startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release-') ||
          startsWith(github.ref_name, 'test-') ||
          startsWith(github.ref_name, 'tinkerpop-') ||
          startsWith(github.head_ref, 'release-') ||
          startsWith(github.head_ref, 'test-') ||
          startsWith(github.head_ref, 'tinkerpop-') ||
          startsWith(github.base_ref, 'release-') ||
          startsWith(github.base_ref, 'test-') ||
          startsWith(github.base_ref, 'tinkerpop-')
        }}
      RAFT_MODE: ${{ startsWith(github.ref_name, 'raft-') || startsWith(github.head_ref, 'raft-') }}

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        JAVA_VERSION: ${{ fromJSON(inputs.java-versions) }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 5

      - name: Prepare HBase container
        if: inputs.backend == 'hbase'
        run: $TRAVIS_DIR/install-backend.sh hbase

      - name: Install Java ${{ matrix.JAVA_VERSION }}
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          java-version: ${{ matrix.JAVA_VERSION }}
          distribution: 'zulu'
          cache: maven
          cache-jdk: false

      - name: Use staged maven repo settings
        if: ${{ env.USE_STAGE == 'true' }}
        run: |
          cp $HOME/.m2/settings.xml /tmp/settings.xml
          cp -vf .github/configs/settings.xml $HOME/.m2/settings.xml && cat $HOME/.m2/settings.xml

      - name: Compile
        run: |
          mvn clean compile -pl hugegraph-server/hugegraph-test -am -U -Dmaven.javadoc.skip=true -ntp

      - name: Check startup and native runtime contracts
        if: inputs.backend == 'rocksdb'
        run: |
          "$TRAVIS_DIR/test-wait-storage.sh"
          "$TRAVIS_DIR/test-start-server.sh"
          "$TRAVIS_DIR/test-riscv64-java-runtime.sh"
          bash "$TRAVIS_DIR/test-tinkerpop-reports.sh"

      - name: Validate Docker integration
        if: ${{ env.BACKEND == 'rocksdb' }}
        run: |
          bash hugegraph-server/hugegraph-dist/docker/docker-entrypoint-test.sh
          bash docker/test-compose.sh render

      - name: Run check_port unit tests
        if: ${{ env.BACKEND == 'rocksdb' }}
        run: |
          # Validates the ss/netstat port preflight that replaced lsof
          $TRAVIS_DIR/test-check-port.sh \
            hugegraph-server/hugegraph-dist/src/assembly/static \
            hugegraph-store/hg-store-dist/src/assembly/static/bin/util.sh

      - name: Run Java security properties tests
        if: ${{ env.BACKEND == 'rocksdb' }}
        run: |
          mvn package -Dmaven.test.skip=true -pl hugegraph-server/hugegraph-dist -am -ntp
          VERSION=$(mvn help:evaluate -Dexpression=project.version -q -DforceStdout)
          SERVER_DIR=hugegraph-server/apache-hugegraph-server-$VERSION/
          $TRAVIS_DIR/test-java-security-properties.sh \
            "$SERVER_DIR" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"

      - name: Check bundled Arthas local CLI
        if: ${{ env.BACKEND == 'rocksdb' }}
        run: |
          VERSION=$(mvn help:evaluate -Dexpression=project.version -q -DforceStdout)
          SERVER_DIR=hugegraph-server/apache-hugegraph-server-$VERSION
          bash "$TRAVIS_DIR/test-arthas-cli.sh" "$SERVER_DIR"

      - name: Verify Surefire single-class routing
        if: ${{ env.BACKEND == 'rocksdb' }}
        run: |
          SUREFIRE_DIR=hugegraph-server/hugegraph-test/target/surefire-reports
          REPORT="$SUREFIRE_DIR/TEST-org.apache.hugegraph.unit.auth.HugeGraphAuthProxyTest.xml"
          rm -f "$REPORT"
          set -o pipefail
          RUNTIME_LOG=$(mktemp "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-runtime.XXXXXX")
          mvn test -pl hugegraph-server/hugegraph-test -am \
            -P unit-test -Dtest=HugeGraphAuthProxyTest -ntp 2>&1 | tee "$RUNTIME_LOG"
          bash "$TRAVIS_DIR/check-java-runtime-logs.sh" "$RUNTIME_LOG"
          test -s "$REPORT" || {
            echo "::error::Server single-class test produced no report"
            exit 1
          }
          NEGATIVE_LOG=$(mktemp)
          trap 'rm -f "$NEGATIVE_LOG"' EXIT
          if mvn test -pl hugegraph-server/hugegraph-test -am \
            -P unit-test -Dtest=NoSuchJava17ContractTest -ntp \
            >"$NEGATIVE_LOG" 2>&1; then
            cat "$NEGATIVE_LOG"
            echo "::error::Surefire accepted a missing Server test class"
            exit 1
          fi
          cat "$NEGATIVE_LOG"
          grep -Fq 'No tests matching pattern "NoSuchJava17ContractTest"' \
            "$NEGATIVE_LOG"
          grep -Fq '(unit-test) @ hugegraph-test' "$NEGATIVE_LOG"

      - name: Check startup test prerequisites
        id: server-preflight
        if: ${{ env.BACKEND == 'rocksdb' }}
        run: |
          # Note: lsof removed from prerequisites; check_port now uses ss, falling back
          # to netstat, and warns without blocking when neither can answer.
          # This job always runs on Linux (ubuntu-24.04), which uses fuser for port cleanup.
          for tool in crontab curl java; do
            if ! command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "can_run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "skip_reason=missing tool: $tool" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          if ! command -v fuser >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "can_run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "skip_reason=missing tool: fuser (required for Linux port cleanup)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "can_run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Run start-hugegraph.sh foreground mode tests
        if: ${{ env.BACKEND == 'rocksdb' && steps.server-preflight.outputs.can_run == 'true' }}
        run: |
          VERSION=$(mvn help:evaluate -Dexpression=project.version -q -DforceStdout)
          SERVER_DIR=hugegraph-server/apache-hugegraph-server-$VERSION/
          bash $TRAVIS_DIR/test-ci-service-utils.sh "$TRAVIS_DIR/ci-service-utils.sh"
          bash $TRAVIS_DIR/test-launcher-gc.sh "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
          bash $TRAVIS_DIR/test-cgroup-memory.sh "$SERVER_DIR/bin/util.sh"
          bash $TRAVIS_DIR/test-start-hugegraph-signal.sh "$SERVER_DIR/bin/start-hugegraph.sh"
          $TRAVIS_DIR/test-start-hugegraph.sh $SERVER_DIR

      - name: Startup tests skipped (missing prerequisites)
        if: ${{ env.BACKEND == 'rocksdb' && steps.server-preflight.outputs.can_run == 'false' }}
        run: |
          echo "::notice::Server startup tests skipped — ${{ steps.server-preflight.outputs.skip_reason }}"

      - name: Run unit test
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          RUNTIME_LOG=$(mktemp "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-runtime.XXXXXX")
          $TRAVIS_DIR/run-unit-test.sh $BACKEND 2>&1 | tee "$RUNTIME_LOG"
          bash "$TRAVIS_DIR/check-java-runtime-logs.sh" "$RUNTIME_LOG"

      - name: Run core test
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          RUNTIME_LOG=$(mktemp "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-runtime.XXXXXX")
          $TRAVIS_DIR/run-core-test.sh $BACKEND 2>&1 | tee "$RUNTIME_LOG"
          bash "$TRAVIS_DIR/check-java-runtime-logs.sh" "$RUNTIME_LOG"

      - name: Run api test
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          RUNTIME_LOG=$(mktemp "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-runtime.XXXXXX")
          {
            if [ "$BACKEND" = "rocksdb" ]; then
              $TRAVIS_DIR/run-api-test.sh $BACKEND $REPORT_DIR true
            else
              $TRAVIS_DIR/run-api-test.sh $BACKEND $REPORT_DIR
            fi
          } 2>&1 | tee "$RUNTIME_LOG"
          bash "$TRAVIS_DIR/check-java-runtime-logs.sh" "$RUNTIME_LOG"

      # TODO: disable raft test in normal PR due to the always timeout problem
      - name: Run raft test
        if: ${{ env.RAFT_MODE == 'true' && env.BACKEND == 'rocksdb' }}
        timeout-minutes: 45
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          RUNTIME_LOG=$(mktemp "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-runtime.XXXXXX")
          $TRAVIS_DIR/run-api-test-for-raft.sh $BACKEND $REPORT_DIR 2>&1 | tee "$RUNTIME_LOG"
          bash "$TRAVIS_DIR/check-java-runtime-logs.sh" "$RUNTIME_LOG"

      - name: Run TinkerPop structure test
        if: ${{ env.RUN_TINKERPOP_TESTS == 'true' && (env.BACKEND == 'memory' || env.BACKEND == 'rocksdb') }}
        timeout-minutes: 60
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          RUNTIME_LOG=$(mktemp "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-runtime.XXXXXX")
          $TRAVIS_DIR/run-tinkerpop-test.sh $BACKEND structure 2>&1 | tee "$RUNTIME_LOG"
          bash "$TRAVIS_DIR/check-java-runtime-logs.sh" "$RUNTIME_LOG"

      - name: Run TinkerPop process test
        if: ${{ env.RUN_TINKERPOP_TESTS == 'true' && (env.BACKEND == 'memory' || env.BACKEND == 'rocksdb') }}
        timeout-minutes: 180
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          RUNTIME_LOG=$(mktemp "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-runtime.XXXXXX")
          $TRAVIS_DIR/run-tinkerpop-test.sh $BACKEND process 2>&1 | tee "$RUNTIME_LOG"
          bash "$TRAVIS_DIR/check-java-runtime-logs.sh" "$RUNTIME_LOG"

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: ${{ env.REPORT_DIR }}/*.xml,hugegraph-server/target/site/jacoco/jacoco.xml
          flags: server_${{ inputs.backend }}
          disable_search: true
          fail_ci_if_error: false

      - name: Stop HBase container
        if: ${{ always() && inputs.backend == 'hbase' }}
        run: |
          "$TRAVIS_DIR/install-hbase.sh" stop
